verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile documentation only describes encoding a project's own Homebrew-managed dependencies (analogous to package.json/Gemfile/requirements.txt) and dumping/installing Homebrew's own state — there is no documented import or conversion tool that migrates an existing project's dependency manifest from another package manager (e.g. apt, MacPorts, Nix, npm-only setups) into Homebrew's format. No evidence of such conversion tooling appears anywhere in the pack.
